title: About Us
detailHtml:
We're committed to providing safe, reliable ground transportation throughout the New York Capital Region.

Albany Airport Taxi and Limo Service provides taxi, car, and SUV service to and from your local airport, along with long-distance and courier service throughout the region. Our drivers provide courteous, prompt transportation whether you're headed to the airport, coming home after an evening out, or traveling with clients.

Call us anytime, day or night, to book your ride or ask about rates.

title: Privacy Policy
detailHtml:
Dear customer, we would be glad if you could spare a minute or two to go through our privacy policy and terms of use. We assure you that we take great care of our customers' privacy, and that any personal information you share with us is kept safely and not shared with third parties.

Tracking traffic on our site

We use Google Analytics to track web traffic on our site. The only information we track is general location and site usage — user identities remain anonymous. We use this data only for internal reporting purposes.

Use of cookies and IP logging

Our site may use cookies or log IP addresses for security and anti-fraud purposes. These are standard practices used by most websites today. When you submit a request through our contact form, we may log your IP address to validate the request and prevent spam.

Use of personal information

When you contact us through our website, we ask for information like your name, email, and phone number so we can respond to your request. This information remains private and is never shared with third parties.
